name: WABISABI
source:
The summer blue sky over a verdant mountain village.
Across endless rice fields as far as the eye can see,
A refreshing breeze blows through.

“Welcome home!!”

Kousuke comes home from studying at an art college in the city,
and there to welcome him are adorable and kind goddesses who love him dearly.

Feelings and emotions come together,
and grow like budding leaves
as this gentle and warm story begins.

[From [url=https://lecode-net.biz/contents/wabisabi/index_en.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
夏日的蓝天笼罩着青翠的山村。
放眼望去，一望无际的稻田，
一阵清爽的微风吹过。

“欢迎回家！！”

浩介从城里的一所艺术学院学习回来，
在那里迎接他的是可爱又善良的女神，她们深爱着他。

感觉和情绪交织在一起，
并像新叶一样生长
当这个温柔而温暖的故事开始时。

[摘自[url=https://lecode-net.biz/contents/wabisabi/index_en.html]官方网站[/url]]
